text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children over their parents, mentioning examples from the Prophetic Sunnah about treating children with kindness and tarbiyah (upbringing) through rifq (gentleness). It also highlights the importance of raising children with good akhlaq (character) and giving them attention.

review_defects.english: the rights of children over their parents
review_defects.why: Arabic says 'الآباء' (fathers) specifically, but English generalizes to 'parents', which includes mothers and broadens the meaning.
